_comment: The Grade 1 English standalone lesson build, described for ../../mathematics/lesson-app-tools. Order here IS the unit number, and here it is also the COURSE's unit number: unlike the Maths builds, whose lessons are organised by strand, one lesson is one unit of the shell course. See THE UNIT PROBLEM in wire-progress.py and the README beside this file before changing progressUnitPrefix - that 1:1 mapping makes u01..u10 defensible for the first time, and it is a curriculum decision rather than a wiring one.
